step1_analysis.circuit_type: Feedback MOS Current Mode Logic (FMCML) Gate
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed current mode logic gate utilizing a dynamic feedback network to adjust load resistance. It is designed for gigabit multiplexer/demultiplexer applications, offering tolerance to threshold voltage fluctuations.

paper_reference.title: 0.18-m CMOS 10-Gb/s Multiplexer/Demultiplexer ICs Using Current Mode Logic with Tolerance to Threshold Voltage Fluctuation

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the logic gate.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a tail current of ~0.5mA to 1mA per gate. Power = VDD * I_tail = 1.8V * 0.5mA = 0.9mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 0.4W reported is for the full MUX/DEMUX IC. A single MCML gate typically consumes around 1mW in 130nm/180nm nodes.

Voltage Swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the differential outputs.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_swing = I_tail * R_load. With I_tail=0.5mA and R_load=1kOhm, swing is 0.5V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: MCML achieves high speed by keeping voltage swings small, preventing transistors from entering deep triode or cutoff.

Propagation Delay.description: Time delay from the input crossing its midpoint to the output crossing its midpoint.

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay ≈ (C_load * V_swing) / I_tail. For sky130, parasitic capacitances will yield higher delays than highly optimized 180nm custom layouts.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 2ps reported in the paper likely refers to a specific phase error or highly optimized unloaded path. Standard gate delay in sky130 is typically 20-50ps.
To support multi-gigabit operation, the analog bandwidth of the gate must be in the GHz range.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC bandwidth, transient voltage swing, and propagation delay of the FMCML gate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* FMCML Gate Testbench
.lib "sky130_fd_pr/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N1 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N6 N0 N1 N1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N0 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 N6 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 GND VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 N4 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 N1 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N5 LABEL_NET_0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N5 N1 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 GND LABEL_NET_1 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N2 LABEL_NET_2 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.2 1G)
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.2 1G)

* Prevent floating node errors (due to potential extraction anomalies)
R_N0 N0 0 1G
R_N6 N6 0 1G

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis for Bandwidth
  ac dec 10 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(N2)
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
  meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis for Swing and Delay
  tran 10p 5n
  meas tran v_max max v(N2)
  meas tran v_min min v(N2)
  let v_swing = v_max - v_min
  print v_swing
  
  * Measure propagation delay (assuming output crosses 0.9V)
  meas tran delay trig v(LABEL_NET_0) val=0.9 rise=2 targ v(N2) val=0.9 fall=2
  
  quit
.endc
.end
